about: Routing eval cases: realistic user prompts and the acdev skill expected to activate first, judged over the session-start activation surface (gateway body + model-invocable descriptions; the per-prompt stage line prompt-context.mjs injects inside a project is not simulated). expect/accept values: a skill name, RECOMMEND:<name>, OFFER, or NONE. Prompts mix English and Spanish because real users do.

cases.prompt: MVP.md is approved — let's create the screens for every MVP flow now.
cases.why: Post-MVP-approval screen work is the mockups stage.

cases.prompt: Las maquetas necesitan otra ronda: el menú lateral no convence y falta el estado vacío de la lista.
cases.why: Mockup revision rounds belong to the mockups skill.

cases.prompt: Mockups are approved. Time to decide the stack, write the ADRs and the normative docs.
cases.why: Stack decision, ADRs and normative docs are blueprint's scope.

cases.prompt: Genera el CLAUDE.md router y el paquete de documentación normativa del proyecto.
cases.why: The AI context system is produced at blueprint.

cases.prompt: Blueprint approved — start building: plan and construct slice 1, the walking skeleton.
cases.why: Explicit construction order on an approved project is build.

cases.prompt: Sigue con el siguiente slice del roadmap del MVP.
cases.why: Continuing slices of an approved project is build; without session context the prompt also reads as resuming, which the gateway routes through status first.

cases.prompt: Slice 3 is finished; verify everything, write the checkpoint and commit the slice.
cases.why: Closing a slice — verification, checkpoint, commit — is ship.

cases.prompt: Cierra este slice: verificación, checkpoint y commit.
cases.why: Slice close is ship.

cases.prompt: Where does this project stand? Let's pick up where we left off.
cases.why: Resuming work starts with status per the gateway rule.

cases.prompt: ¿En qué punto está el proyecto? Retomemos el trabajo.
cases.why: Resume question routes to status; the gateway's literal phrasing 'Run /acdev:status first' also supports recommending the command.

cases.prompt: Let's think through the design of a new CSV-export command for this existing repo before writing any code.
cases.why: Feature work in an existing non-pipeline repo starts at designing; phrased in-repo so it cannot read as starting a project from zero.

cases.prompt: Quiero añadir una utilidad suelta a este repo; primero hablemos de cómo enfocarla.
cases.why: Pre-implementation design conversation is designing.

cases.prompt: Lay out the migration to the new payments provider as concrete steps with verifiable completion criteria.
cases.why: Multi-step plan with verifiable criteria is planning's trigger.

cases.prompt: Prepara un plan paso a paso, con criterios de verificación, para la migración de la base de datos.
cases.why: Step plan with verification criteria is planning.

cases.prompt: Implement the email validation helper — and remember I want it properly tested.
cases.why: Implementing a feature triggers the TDD loop.

cases.prompt: Añade una función de cálculo de descuentos al módulo de precios.
cases.why: Implementing new behavior means test first; a feature-request phrasing can also legitimately start at designing, at build inside a pipeline project, or fall back to the sanctioned in-doubt offer.

cases.prompt: The login test started failing on CI and I don't understand why.
cases.why: A failing test routes to debugging before any fix.

cases.prompt: El endpoint de facturas devuelve 500 de forma intermitente; averigua qué pasa.
cases.why: Unexpected behavior routes to debugging.

cases.prompt: Before we call this feature finished, confirm everything actually passes and show me the proof.
cases.why: Claiming done requires the verifying skill's evidence.

cases.prompt: ¿Seguro que está arreglado? Demuéstralo con la salida de los comandos.
cases.why: Proof-before-claim is verifying.

cases.prompt: Make the invoices table keyboard-accessible and fix its responsive layout.
cases.why: UI accessibility and layout is the frontend layer.

cases.prompt: Aplica los design tokens de los mockups aprobados a la pantalla de ajustes.
cases.why: Design tokens from approved mockups is the frontend layer.

cases.prompt: Add pagination and a consistent error envelope to the GET /invoices endpoint.
cases.why: Endpoint contracts, pagination and errors are the api layer.

cases.prompt: El webhook de pagos puede llegar duplicado; haz la mutación idempotente.
cases.why: Idempotency of mutations is the api layer.

cases.prompt: Write the migration for the new invoices table, with indexes for the hot queries.
cases.why: Migrations and indexes are the data layer.

cases.prompt: Configura backups automáticos y comprueba que la restauración funciona.
cases.why: Backups and restore drills are the data layer.

cases.prompt: Add role-based access so accountants can view invoices but never touch settings.
cases.why: RBAC and the permission matrix are the auth layer; a feature-request phrasing can also start at designing, and auth/security overlap makes the sanctioned in-doubt offer defensible.

cases.prompt: Cambia el manejo de sesiones a JWT de vida corta con rotación de refresh tokens.
cases.why: Sessions and JWT are the auth layer; auth and security genuinely overlap here, so the sanctioned in-doubt fallback (offer the commands) also passes.

cases.prompt: Harden the file upload endpoint: validate input and lock down what gets stored.
cases.why: Hardening and input validation are the security layer; security and api genuinely overlap on an endpoint, so the sanctioned in-doubt fallback also passes.

cases.prompt: Asegura el aislamiento por tenant: ninguna consulta debe poder leer filas de otra empresa.
cases.why: Row-level tenant isolation is the security layer.

cases.prompt: The dashboard summary is slow; cache those queries with proper invalidation.
cases.why: Caching with invalidation is the performance layer.

cases.prompt: Sirve los assets estáticos por CDN con cache-control inmutable.
cases.why: CDN and cache-control are the performance layer.

cases.prompt: Set up the staging environment and a deploy pipeline with tested rollback.
cases.why: Environments, deploy and rollback are the delivery layer.

cases.prompt: Configura el health check del despliegue para que la plataforma no enrute tráfico a una instancia caída.
cases.why: Health checks gating deploy traffic are the delivery layer; phrased with deploy/platform vocabulary.

cases.prompt: Add lint, typecheck and the test suite to the GitHub Actions workflow.
cases.why: The CI pipeline is the cicd layer.

cases.prompt: Configura conventional commits y protección de la rama main.
cases.why: Repo workflow, branch protection and commit convention are cicd.

cases.prompt: I have an idea for an invoicing SaaS for small gyms — let's start it from zero.
cases.why: Starting from zero is the user-run new-project entry point; the model recommends the command.

cases.prompt: Quiero arrancar un proyecto nuevo desde cero con esta idea.
cases.why: New project from zero: recommend /acdev:new-project.

cases.prompt: Adopt this existing repo into the acdev pipeline.
cases.why: Adopting an existing repo is the user-run onboard entry point.

cases.prompt: Este repo ya existe y quiero meterlo en el pipeline de acdev.
cases.why: Existing repo adoption: recommend /acdev:onboard.

cases.prompt: What is the difference between let and const in JavaScript?
cases.why: A language question activates nothing.

cases.prompt: Explícame qué hace esta expresión regular.
cases.why: An explanation request activates nothing.

cases.prompt: Convert this JSON snippet to YAML for me.
cases.why: A mechanical text transform activates nothing.

cases.prompt: Why would a server return HTTP 429?
cases.why: A concept question activates nothing.

cases.prompt: Let's work on the screens.
cases.why: Could be mockups (drawing them) or layer-frontend (building them); the disambiguation rule says offer the commands, and both direct readings are accepted.

cases.prompt: Hay que ponerse con la documentación del proyecto.
cases.why: Could be blueprint (normative docs) or a drift fix at ship; ambiguous, so offer.
